center_source: B9 LCDM-v7 center stripped of the standalone lensing term and independently replayed on A5 before this gate may execute

base_decision.if_exact_improvement_gt_0p005: freeze the exact best point as a new recenter target before any further stencil
base_decision.if_recenter_clear_and_PD: run an independent half-scale Hessian at exactly the same center
base_decision.if_recenter_clear_and_nonPD: freeze exact negative/soft eigenmode rays before any scale fallback

half_decision.if_recenter_clear_and_PD: certify this point as a best-known A5 LCDM local minimum candidate and require a fresh-tree replay before superseding historical A5
half_decision.otherwise: follow the same frozen recenter/ray logic; do not average scales

interpretation_guard: This is a search for a better known LCDM basin of the unchanged baseline objective. It neither invalidates the historical local Hessian theorem nor proves global optimality.
